other_conditions: Girl’s birth must be registered within one year of birth.
The girl must not be engaged in child labour.
The girl must be immunized as per the health department’s program.
Girl children must be born after 31 March 2006 in a BPL family.
Benefits are limited to families with up to two female children.
The girl must have completed eighth grade to receive the maturity amount.
The girl cannot be married before turning 18 years old.
benefits_summary: Provides health insurance up to Rs. 25,000 per year, annual scholarships ranging from Rs. 300 to Rs. 1,000, a maturity payment of Rs. 34,751 at age 18, and additional accident and death benefits.
